Device D008254 connects to 5 cards in the 7-day window with 100% of transactions scoring over 0.5 (lift 48.43), including card C06224-K2 in ring 37749036 just 32 minutes later and card C11309-K1 in ring 34603052 two days prior.

Transaction 3503878 for $99.92 matches a rapid succession of near-identical ~$100 online transactions on device D008254, including $100.06 on card C11309-K1 and $100.00 on card C06224-K2 within 32 minutes.
Card C07987-K2 has three prior confirmed fraud cases, notably CC-2860 for unauthorized card-not-present online purchases as well as CC-5026 and CC-2011 for out-of-region use.
The holder baseline shows no prior transactions and no recurring charge pattern for the $99.92 charge, providing no positive indication of authorized use.
Billing region 264 shows a below-average fraud rate with a lift of 0.42 across 2,869 transactions in the window.

evidence.claim: Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Online transaction 3503878 for $99.92 on card C07987-K2 was flagged with a calibrated model score of 0.784 and risk score of 0.90. The purchase was made through device D008254, which was new to the account and possessed no prior history with the cardholder. Graph analysis revealed that device D008254 was active across five cards within seven days, executing rapid succession near-$100 transactions on cards associated with known fraud rings. Card C07987-K2 also has prior confirmed fraud cases, including CC-2860 for online card-not-present fraud. The transaction was determined to be card-not-present fraud via a new device, prompting card blocking and reporting actions.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details card-not-present fraud identified on card C07987-K2 belonging to customer C07987. On December 1, 2016, at 17:28:53, an unauthorized online transaction of $99.92 was conducted in billing region 264 under transaction ID 3503878. The transaction was conducted using device D008254, characterized by the device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720', which was new to the cardholder account. Transaction monitoring scored the transaction at 0.784 with a historical fraud rate of 77.96% and a real-time risk score of 0.90. Graph analysis demonstrated that device D008254 was used across five distinct payment cards within a seven-day window, showing an extreme fraud lift of 48.43. Device D008254 was used in rapid succession for a $100.06 transaction on card C11309-K1 on November 29, 2016, and a $100.00 transaction on card C06224-K2 just 32 minutes after the flagged purchase. Both connected cards belong to confirmed fraud rings 34603052 and 37749036, and are linked alongside cards C01104-K2 and C01983-K1. Additionally, card C07987-K2 has prior confirmed fraud history under closed cases CC-2860, CC-5026, and CC-2011. Total direct unauthorized exposure is $99.92. Card C07987-K2 has been blocked to prevent further loss, and related accounts have been queued for ongoing monitoring.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped under policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached 0.94, well exceeding the decisive 0.85 threshold, supported by multiple independent incriminating bases including calibrated model score, cross-card links to fraud rings, and prior confirmed fraud history.
